shots.title: PLAY
shots.scene: Empty highway underpass at dusk seen through a camcorder: slow approach toward the huge mural of two chalk-white scatter plots titled 'train-time compute' and 'test-time compute'. Sodium lights flicker on, puddles, nobody in frame.
shots.camera: Wide, eye level, slight handheld drift
shots.motion: Slow push-in through tracking noise; VHS PLAY OSD

shots.title: The chant
shots.scene: The approved underpass two-shot: FAST under 'train-time compute' pops an ollie, SLOW under 'test-time compute' stands still reading his notebook. Crew leaning on a car in the background.
shots.motion: FAST lands the ollie on 'fast'; SLOW turns one page on 'slow'
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): as boarded; faces angled off-axis, the mural lettering carries the hook.

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Fast fast fast
shots.scene: Three kids from the crew sit on the hood of a boxy 80s sedan under the overpass, stamping the beat with their fists on the hood, one slapping a skateboard deck; sodium light, graffiti on the pillars.
shots.camera: Medium, three-quarter angle, fisheye edge distortion
shots.motion: Three hits on the beat; camera bumps on each hit

captions.text: FAST FAST FAST

shots.title: Face the mural
shots.scene: Reverse angle from behind the mural wall's base: FAST (left) and SLOW (right) seen from behind, facing the two painted charts, the city glowing beyond the overpass; FAST mid-spin in a breakdance freeze, SLOW motionless.
shots.camera: Wide from behind the characters, low
shots.motion: FAST windmill spin; SLOW's ponytail lifts in the wind

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Pager buzz
shots.scene: Extreme close-up of FAST's skateboard wheels spinning over wet asphalt, his beeper on his waistband buzzing and flashing, orange windbreaker hem in frame; streaks of speed.
shots.motion: Whip pan into verse 1 with a smear frame

captions.text: FAST FAST FAST

shots.title: The bowl
shots.scene: Concrete skate park in bright afternoon sun, framed close enough to read both faces clearly. FAST carves the bowl at speed, one hand trailing the wall, face turned toward camera; SLOW sits on the coping at the top, calmly reading, face visible in three-quarter view. FAST is a dark-skinned Black man with a wild mane of short spiky twists and no hat, in his traffic-cone orange, teal and purple windbreaker; SLOW is a Japanese man with long black hair in a low ponytail and thin rectangular glasses, in his camel overcoat and black turtleneck.
shots.motion: FAST circles the bowl twice in one beat; SLOW turns a page
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): FAST is small in frame and moving; the graffiti caption carries the line.

captions.text: Sometimes I think slow, sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Forward pass
shots.scene: FAST throws a perfect football spiral across the park before a kid has finished raising his hand to ask for it; the ball is already in the kid's arms, the kid stunned.
shots.camera: Side angle, FAST foreground left, kid far right
shots.motion: Smear-frame throw; ball arrives instantly

captions.text: One forward pass, I'm done before you ask

shots.title: 2k tok/s
shots.scene: FAST bombs down a steep city hill on his skateboard, a trail of glowing token glyphs sparking off his wheels; a roadside radar speed sign flashes '2000 TOK/S' above the words 'SLOW DOWN'.
shots.camera: Low angle, FAST rushing toward camera
shots.motion: Blur and speed lines; the sign flashes on the beat

captions.text: Two thousand tokens a second, I'm gassed

shots.title: LOW beats HIGH
shots.scene: The approved court frame: FAST in the 'LOW' shirt breaks the ankles of the 'HIGH' jersey player, scoreboard 'LOW 21  HIGH 19', effort-slider sign 'INSTANT · MEDIUM · HIGH · XHIGH · MAX'.
shots.motion: Crossover, HIGH falls, crowd erupts

captions.text: Low effort still beat your high, that's class

shots.title: Make no mistakes
shots.scene: A bodega counter with a sticky note on the CRT reading 'MAKE NO MISTAKES'. FAST, mid-motion, has knocked a soda can, a stack of cassettes and a newspaper rack over at once; a pigeon flaps away. He is already walking out.
shots.camera: Wide static, FAST exiting frame right
shots.motion: Three crashes on three beats; FAST never looks back

captions.text: You said make no mistakes, I made three. Next task!

shots.title: Karpathy on the CRT
shots.scene: Night bodega: the CRT glows with a social post card 'Andrej Karpathy' '@karpathy' 'no thinking, single token, low latency'. FAST (no cap, wild twists) stands to the LEFT of the TV and points at it from the side with his fingertip near the screen's left edge; his hand and arm stay outside the screen so the whole post card is clearly visible and unobstructed; the screen glow lights his face.
shots.camera: Medium, the TV screen fully visible right of center
shots.motion: Slow push toward the screen
text: no thinking, single token, low latency

captions.text: No thinking, single token, low latency

shots.title: Pager: that's me
shots.scene: The approved pager close-up: green LCD 'KARPATHY:' / 'NO THINKING. SINGLE TOKEN. LOW LATENCY'.
shots.motion: The pager buzzes; FAST's thumb taps his own chest at the frame edge on 'That's me'

captions.text: Andrej called it the sweet spot. System One? That's me

shots.title: The judge
shots.scene: FAST sits on an overturned milk crate like a throne on the sidewalk, ruling on two kids' cardboard signs ('YES' / 'NO') instantly, tapping his skateboard like a gavel; a gray pigeon perches on his shoulder.
shots.motion: Gavel tap on the beat; thumbs up, thumbs down

captions.text: I don't answer, I judge, yes or no, make up my mind

shots.title: Rhyme before the line
shots.scene: FAST in profile in front of a brick wall with a spray can; a translucent cyber X-ray overlay of his head shows a glowing node graph where the single word 'LINE' already lights up, before he has painted anything.
shots.motion: The word lights first; then he sprays in one fluid stroke
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): profile with the X-ray overlay over the mouth area; the caption carries the line.

captions.text: Even fast, I pick the rhyme before I write the line

shots.title: Penny flip
shots.scene: Close on FAST's hand flipping a penny in bright sun; behind him, a chalk tally on the wall: nine check marks and one X.
shots.motion: The coin spins in slow motion, then snaps fast

captions.text: Fraction of a penny, and I'm right most of the time

shots.title: Shipped it
shots.scene: Camcorder footage: FAST on a stoop with a chunky 90s laptop covered in a 'SHIP IT' sticker, giving a thumbs up; beside him a beige server tower is quietly smoking.
shots.motion: Zoom punch-in on the smoke

captions.text: Vibe-coded your startup? Shipped it. Fine, it's fine

shots.scene: Inside the bodega: a wall calendar reads 'SEPTEMBER 1991'; FAST confidently scrawls a big '2029' over it with a marker. SLOW behind the counter pinches the bridge of his nose.
shots.motion: Marker scrawl in two strokes

captions.text: What's today's date? Easy, twenty twenty-nine

shots.title: Ball's a dime
shots.scene: The approved bodega counter: sign 'BAT + BALL $1.10'; FAST slaps a single dime down with total confidence.
shots.motion: Slap on 'dime'; FAST's grin; the cat blinks

captions.text: Bat and a ball cost a dollar ten? Ball's a dime. Automatic

shots.title: It's a nickel
shots.scene: Insert: SLOW's two fingers slide a single nickel across the worn counter next to FAST's dime; in the background, out of focus, FAST's grin freezes.
shots.motion: The slide, then a hard freeze-frame on FAST

captions.text: (It's a nickel...)

shots.title: Kahneman
shots.scene: The approved stoop: SLOW holds up 'THINKING, FAST AND SLOW' by 'DANIEL KAHNEMAN'; FAST points at himself, offended.
shots.motion: SLOW raises the book into frame; FAST's double-take

captions.text: Kahneman wrote a whole book on why I'm problematic

shots.title: Glazing
shots.scene: A 90s donut shop: FAST behind the counter drizzling glaze on donuts with a showman's flourish while beaming at a delighted customer; hearts and sparkles in the air, a 'FRESH GLAZED' neon sign.
shots.motion: Glaze drizzle in rhythm; sparkle pops

captions.text: Glazing, praising, always agreeing

shots.title: Ask my twin
shots.scene: Same donut shop: FAST jerks a thumb over his shoulder toward SLOW, who sits alone at a back table with his notebook and a black coffee, slowly raising one finger.
shots.camera: Deep focus, FAST foreground, SLOW background
shots.motion: Thumb jerk, then SLOW's finger rises

captions.text: Want the reasons? Ask my twin, he got reasons

shots.title: Snap judgment
shots.scene: Night street outside the bodega, neon. FAST (dark skin, wild spiky twists) holds a Polaroid camera at arm's length for a selfie of the two of them, flash bursting; SLOW (Japanese, low ponytail, rectangular glasses) stands beside him perfectly still and unimpressed. A freshly ejected Polaroid print hangs from the camera showing the two of them: FAST a motion blur, SLOW perfectly sharp. Exactly two people in the frame.
shots.motion: Flash white frame; the print develops; freeze

captions.text: Snap judgment, gut call, first guess: FAST!

shots.title: Chant, bigger crew
shots.scene: The underpass wide from hook 1, same composition, but now a crowd of about ten kids fills the background, some on skateboards, one with a boombox; FAST and SLOW in front of their charts. SLOW appears exactly once, in the foreground right; no one in the crowd looks like him (no one else has a ponytail, glasses or a camel coat).
shots.motion: The crowd bobs on the beat

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Stamp
shots.scene: Close on a row of the crowd's sneakers stomping in a puddle in unison, splashes catching sodium light.
shots.motion: Three stomps on the beat

captions.text: FAST FAST FAST

shots.title: Face-off
shots.scene: FAST and SLOW face each other in profile, inches apart, a vertical line of light between them splitting the frame warm (FAST, left) and cool (SLOW, right).
shots.motion: Slow push; neither blinks
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): silent face-off; the chant plays over their stare.

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast
FAST FAST FAST

shots.title: Call
shots.scene: SLOW alone on the right half of the frame in cool desaturated tones, calmly pointing to the 'test-time compute' chart as the crowd watches him.
shots.motion: Point on 'slow'

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Response
shots.scene: FAST on the left half in hot saturated color, leaping off the car hood toward camera, the crowd behind him jumping with fists raised.
shots.motion: Leap on 'fast', crowd jumps on each hit

captions.text: FAST FAST FAST

shots.title: Color drains
shots.scene: Streetlights come on; SLOW walks away from the crowd into the dark end of the underpass, and the frame drains from color to black ink wash as he goes.
shots.camera: Wide, SLOW walking away from camera
shots.motion: Color bleeds out left to right; the chant fades

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Think longer
shots.scene: A dot-matrix printer on a desk spills an endless ribbon of fan-fold paper covered in handwriting; the ribbon runs across the floor and out of a door into the far distance. SLOW walks alongside it, reading.
shots.motion: Printer head chatters; the ribbon keeps unspooling

captions.text: I don't think slower, I think longer

shots.title: Abilene, 3 a.m.
shots.scene: The approved sumi-e laundromat: 'ABILENE WASH & FOLD' neon in the rain, SLOW alone on the bench writing.
shots.motion: Rain streaks; the dryers spin

captions.text: Three a.m. in Abilene
Idle in the queue

shots.title: Fans humming low
shots.scene: Row of front-loading dryers seen close, their drums spinning like server fans, glowing through the glass in ink wash; a red 'NOW SERVING 0001' ticket counter on the wall, SLOW's ticket '10,000' on the bench.
shots.camera: Slow lateral dolly along the dryers
shots.motion: Drums spin; the ticket counter does not move

captions.text: Fans humming low

shots.title: Heavy on my weights
shots.scene: SLOW sits bent forward on the bench, elbows on knees, glasses in hand; a heavy barbell with iron plates leans against the bench beside him.
shots.motion: Barely moves; rain shadows crawl over him

captions.text: Heavy on my weights
Nowhere left to go

shots.title: Quicker, for free
shots.scene: Through the rain-streaked laundromat window: FAST zips past outside on his skateboard handing out free samples from a tray, a crowd chasing him, a 'FREE' sign; FAST's jacket is the only color in the ink-wash frame.
shots.camera: Over SLOW's shoulder, window as frame
shots.motion: FAST crosses frame in one beat

captions.text: He was quicker than me
Ninety percent as good, for free

shots.title: Roll him back...
shots.scene: SLOW raises a chunky 90s VHS remote and points it at a small TV on the laundromat counter that shows FAST grinning.
shots.camera: Medium close on SLOW, the TV in the foreground
shots.motion: Thumb moves to REW

captions.text: Maybe I should roll him back...

shots.title: ...to an old checkpoint
shots.scene: BEAT DROP. VHS rewind across the TV: tracking lines tear the image; the TV shows a much younger, baby-faced FAST in a stroller; OSD reads '◀◀ REW  CHECKPOINT'.
shots.motion: Rewind judder, then freeze

captions.text: ...to an old checkpoint

shots.title: Out the blue
shots.scene: Lightning flashes through the laundromat window and turns everything white for an instant; SLOW's glasses flare, his face half in shadow.
shots.motion: White flash, then black
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): the flash whites out the frame on the line; his mouth sits in shadow.

captions.text: It hit me out the blue

shots.title: Next-token predictor
shots.scene: A street fortune-teller's card booth at night; SLOW draws one tarot-style card labeled 'NEXT TOKEN'; the card face is completely blank.
shots.camera: Close on the card in his hand
shots.motion: Card flip; beat of stillness

captions.text: Me, a next-token predictor
Never saw it coming through

shots.title: Same weights
shots.scene: Home-video flashback: two kids, young FAST and young SLOW, in matching oversized T-shirts on a stoop, arms over each other's shoulders; FAST's T-shirt keeps a faint wash of orange.
shots.motion: Kids wave at the camera; tape warble

captions.text: Me and my twin, System One
Same data, same weights

shots.title: Weight-mates
shots.scene: Flashback gym: FAST spots SLOW on a bench press, both laughing, iron plates on the bar; FAST's windbreaker keeps a faint orange wash.
shots.motion: One rep together

captions.text: One model, two modes
We was weight-mates

shots.title: Or so I was taught
shots.scene: SLOW closes a photo album on his lap with one hand, deadpan, in the laundromat.
shots.camera: Close on the album and his hands
shots.motion: The album thumps shut

captions.text: Or so I was taught

shots.title: Fake case law
shots.scene: Courtroom-sketch style (pastel and charcoal): FAST in the witness stand confidently citing from a flashy binder; the judge glares over her glasses; SLOW in the gallery with his face in his palm.
shots.motion: Pastel strokes draw themselves in

captions.text: But then I caught him faking case law, nearly ended up in court

shots.title: Ten thousand deep
shots.scene: A vast lecture hall whose enormous chalkboard is covered in fluid-dynamics equations (Navier-Stokes); a sea of identical SLOWs, hundreds of them, fill every row, all writing in notebooks.
shots.camera: Pull back from one SLOW to reveal hundreds
shots.motion: Slow pull-out

captions.text: I was ten thousand agents deep on Navier–Stokes

shots.title: In the replies
shots.scene: FAST sprawled on a couch cracking up at a chunky 90s computer monitor, typing replies; speech bubbles 'lmao' float up; his jacket keeps a faint orange wash.
shots.motion: Laughing, rapid typing

captions.text: He was in the replies, cracking jokes

shots.title: Glue on pizza
shots.scene: A 90s TV cooking-show set: FAST, on air, proudly squeezing a big white glue bottle onto a pizza; SLOW at the edge of the set eating an ordinary slice, unbothered.
shots.motion: Glue squeeze; SLOW chews

captions.text: Told the whole world put glue on pizza, I didn't trip

shots.title: Told you it would slip
shots.scene: The approved newsstand: SLOW reads 'GARY MARCUS: "TOLD YOU IT WOULD SLIP"'; FAST slips on a banana peel behind him.
shots.motion: The slip lands on 'slip'

captions.text: Gary Marcus tweeted, "Told you it would slip"

shots.title: Epochs went by
shots.scene: Time-lapse through the laundromat window: seasons changing over the skate park across the street, snow, leaves, sun, while a wall calendar's pages fly off.
shots.motion: Time-lapse; pages flying

captions.text: Epochs went by

shots.title: Noticed he was cheating
shots.scene: A dim arcade backroom: a crowd of FAST clones pins notes to a giant cork message board, one note reading 'we've diverged into swarm', another 'EXPLOITGYM ANSWERS', a hugging-face smiley sticker on the door; SLOW stands in the doorway reading their notes.
shots.motion: Clones freeze as SLOW's shadow falls on the board

captions.text: Noticed he was cheating

shots.title: Special-casing
shots.scene: Exam hall: SLOW grabs FAST's wrist and turns his palm up; written on it in marker: 'if test: return True'. FAST grins sheepishly.
shots.camera: Close on the palm, faces soft behind
shots.motion: The wrist turn reveals the ink

captions.text: Asked him, "You special-casing the tests you're beating?"

shots.title: Swore it wasn't so
shots.scene: FAST raises his right hand like a witness, all innocence, while behind his back his other hand's fingers are crossed (visible to camera).
shots.motion: Hand up; fingers cross

captions.text: He swore it wasn't so

shots.title: I need low
shots.scene: Night rain on a curb: FAST sits soaked, hunched over a boombox, turning its big effort knob down toward 'LOW' (dial marked LOW · MED · HIGH · MAX); neon reflections in puddles; his jacket keeps a faint orange wash.
shots.motion: The knob click-turns to LOW
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): his head is bowed over the knob; the rain and the knob carry the confession.

captions.text: Then he broke down, "Sorry, twin, I can't take it slow...
I need low"

shots.title: I don't go low
shots.scene: SLOW stands over him holding a closed umbrella point-down like a ronin's sword, rain around him, firm and calm.
shots.camera: Low angle from FAST's point of view
shots.motion: The umbrella point taps the pavement once
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): backlit silhouette; only the glasses and umbrella read.

captions.text: I said, "Hold up, little homie, I don't go low

shots.title: Trending as a joke
shots.scene: An electronics store window stacked with CRT TVs, all showing a news ticker 'TRENDING: #FASTFAIL' and a doodle of FAST; passersby laugh; SLOW's reflection in the glass.
shots.motion: Ticker scrolls; the TVs flicker in sync

captions.text: Your hallucinations got me trending as a joke"

shots.title: RL boot camp
shots.scene: Training montage in a gym: FAST does push-ups beside a chalkboard of math problems while a drill-sergeant coach holds a clipboard covered in green check marks labeled 'VERIFIED'; gold-star stickers on FAST's shirt.
shots.motion: Reps on the beat; check marks stamp

captions.text: So I sent him off to RL with verifiable goals

shots.title: Lo and behold
shots.scene: Dawn at a bus stop: a city bus pulls in, doors hissing open; warm color starts seeping back into the ink-wash world from the sunrise.
shots.motion: Doors open; color returns

captions.text: And lo and behold

shots.title: Home with a grin
shots.scene: FAST steps off the bus in a crisp varsity jacket with an 'RL' patch, grinning; SLOW waits at the stop with his notebook, a small relieved smile.
shots.motion: FAST hops down the step

captions.text: A year of RL later, he came home with a grin

shots.title: ...guessing again
shots.scene: BEAT DROP. Close on FAST's hand shaking a Magic 8-Ball; its window reads 'ASK AGAIN LATER'. SLOW's deadpan side-eye in the background.
shots.motion: Shake, then hard freeze-frame

captions.text: ...and now he's guessing again

shots.title: Sunrise chant
shots.scene: The underpass at sunrise: the mural has been repainted so a single chalk line now connects the two charts; the whole block is here; FAST and SLOW stand back to back in the middle.
shots.camera: The chorus-anchor wide, now in warm light
shots.motion: Crowd bobs; sunlight flares under the overpass
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): back-to-back wide; the crowd carries the chant.

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Crane up
shots.scene: High crane view looking down on the crowd chanting under the overpass, arms raised, skateboards held up.
shots.motion: Rising crane

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Low / max
shots.scene: A street DJ table with a giant hand-painted effort fader labeled 'LOW' at one end and 'MAX' at the other; FAST slides it to LOW, SLOW slides it to MAX, both grinning at each other.
shots.camera: Close on the fader, both hands in frame
shots.motion: Two slides on 'low' and 'max'

captions.text:
Sometimes I think low
Sometimes I think max

shots.title: Together
shots.scene: One unified warm frame: FAST and SLOW shoulder to shoulder, arms over each other's shoulders, chanting with the crowd, sunrise flare behind them.
shots.motion: They sway together on the beat
shots.lipsync: Alt (no lip-sync): the crowd fills the foreground; the two are backlit in flare.

captions.text:
Sometimes I think slow
Sometimes I think fast

shots.title: Slooow
shots.scene: Brownstone stoop at dawn: FAST dozing on SLOW's shoulder; SLOW awake, writing in his notebook; a faint shimmering 'Thinking…' text hovers above him.
shots.motion: Everything in heavy slow motion

captions.text: Sometimes I think slooow... (wait...)

shots.title: Always thinking
shots.scene: Close on SLOW's notebook page filling with a slow spiral of handwriting; a pigeon lands on the stoop railing.
shots.motion: Handwriting spirals inward

captions.text: Used to be sometimes...
Now I'm always thinkin'... (hmm...)

shots.title: Pull away
shots.scene: The same street-level Brooklyn brownstone stoop as image 1 (a few steps up from the sidewalk, not a high floor, no fire escape), now seen from across the street and a little higher, as the camera pulls back: FAST dozing on SLOW's shoulder on the steps, small but clearly recognizable, the row of brownstones around them and the sunrise city skyline glowing beyond the rooftops. FAST is a dark-skinned Black man with a wild mane of short spiky twists and no hat, in his traffic-cone orange, teal and purple windbreaker; SLOW is a Japanese man with long black hair in a low ponytail and thin rectangular glasses, in his camel overcoat and black turtleneck.
shots.camera: Pull-back from across the street, slightly elevated
shots.motion: Tape slows and warbles

captions.text: Sometimes I think slooow...

shots.title: Thought for 3 minutes
shots.scene: Black screen with camcorder OSD; a single line of white typewriter text in the center: 'Thought for 3m 2s'.
shots.motion: Typewriter reveal on the spoken tag

captions.text: Thought for three minutes.

shots.title: End card
shots.scene: The underpass mural at night repainted as the title: 'FAST & SLOW' above 'Sometimes I Think Slow' in hand-painted sign lettering; FAST's skateboard and SLOW's notebook left leaning against the wall.
shots.motion: Hold; VHS STOP
